name: Paladin Beacon of Hope
body:
The beacon of hope is a protector to the weak and a builder of hope and community.

Requirements

Alignment and Code of Conduct: A beacon of hope must be lawful good or neutral good, but is still required to adhere to their paladin code. If they commit an evil act, change alignments outside of lawful or neutral good or break their oath, they lose their class features except for proficiencies.

This alters code of conduct.

Protector of Hopes (Su)

At 1st level, a beacon of hope can call upon their divine powers to defend them and those they protect from those who wish to bring violence. This ability functions as smite evil, except that the paladin gains no benefit on attack or damage rolls against their target. Instead, any attacks the target makes against allies within 10 feet of the paladin deal half damage. If the protected ally has HD equal to or less than half the paladin’s HD, the paladin can elect to take the other half of the damage intended for the target. The paladin must take the full damage and is unable to apply their DR, immunities or resistance to this damage. Attacks against the paladin deal full damage, but the paladin gains a deflection bonus to their AC equal to their Charisma bonus (if any) against attacks made by the target of the smite. This bonus increases by +1 for every four paladin levels (to a maximum of +6 at 20th level). As with smite evil, if the paladin targets a creature that is not evil, their protector of hopes ability is wasted with no effect. Feats, abilities, and the like that increase a paladin’s number of uses of smite evil per day increase the beacon of hope’s uses of protector of hopes per day.

This ability replaces smite evil.

Aura of Hope (Su)

At 3rd level, a beacon of hope is immune to despair and gains a +2 sacred bonus on saves vs. fear. Each ally within 10 feet of them gains a +2 morale bonus on saves vs despair and fear effects. This ability functions only when the beacon of hope is conscious, not when they are unconscious or dead.

This ability replaces aura of courage.

Mercies (Su)

Add the following mercies to the mercies available to the beacon of hope.

3rd level
Doubting: The target is no longer doubting.
6th level
Despairing: The target is no longer despairing.
9th level
Hopeless: The target is no longer hopeless

This ability modifies mercies but does not preclude taking another archetype that replaces or modifies mercies.

Improved Protection (Su)

At 11th level, the radius of protection provided by the protector of hopes ability extends to 20 feet. This ability replaces aura of justice.

Aura of Heroism (Su)

At 14th level, the beacon of hope is immune to fear. Additionally any ally within the aura of hope is immune to despair and their bonus to saves against fear increases to +4. This ability functions only while the paladin is conscious, not if she is unconscious or dead. This ability replaces aura of faith.

Protector of the People (Su)

At 20th level, the beacon of hope and their allies within the radius of the protector of hopes ability gain regeneration 10 against the target of their protector of hopes ability (essentially regeneration that is overcome by any damage not caused by the target). This ability replaces holy champion.
